title: Zodiac Coastal Tour with Naturalist Guide: Lunenburg
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
No guests under the age of 6-years-old
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Set off on a military-grade, expedition Zodiac along the Atlantic coastline. Keep your eyes peeled for seals, osprey, eagles, herons, mink, and deer. Learn about the local ecosystem with your guide and snap photos of the flora and fauna along this picturesque stretch of the Atlantic Ocean. Discover a pristine stretch of coastline teeming with wildlife. Cruise safely and comfortably while your naturalist guide points out the local flora, fauna and geology. The tour starts and ends from the wharf at Expedition Nova Scotia located just 10 minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage town of Lunenburg.
